nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address controlling delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated in transferFrom and batchSend
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spent in transferFrom and written in approve/constructor
uint public totalSupply; fixed at construction time
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist consulted in ensure()
uint256 private _saleNum; max transfers per address, set by init and read by condition
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount bound, set by init and read by condition
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount bound, set by init and read by condition
address tradeAddress; address bypassing ensure() checks, set only by owner
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; mints supply to msg.sender, sets owner and unlimited UNI allowance
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; moves balances with raw unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without return-check issues
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist/owner/pair bypass gate built on condition
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits
delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable; owner-only delegatecall into arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of sale limits
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass transfer with unchecked multiplication and subtraction
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only update of tradeAddress bypass entry
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; computes Uniswap pair address via keccak
msg.sender; caller identity used for auth checks, allowance spending and balance accounting

edges.reason: transfer forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
msg.sender becomes _from in the transferFrom call made by transfer
delegate gates execution with require(msg.sender == owner)
delegate reads owner to authorise the caller
init gates configuration with require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend gates mass transfer with require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress gates address change with require(msg.sender == owner)
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints totalSupply to the caller
delegate performs delegatecall on arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances
ensure falls through to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted callers
ensure calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address
ensure reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale limits
ensure compares _from/_to against owner for the whitelist bypass
transferFrom feeds the caller-controlled _from value into ensure
transferFrom subtracts and adds raw balances without SafeMath
transferFrom decrements allowance with unchecked subtraction
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length and subtracts total without overflow checks
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
init sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter

init sets _maxSale = maxToken * 10**decimals
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress bypass address
condition reads _saleNum to bound transfers per address
condition reads _minSale to bound the minimum amount
condition reads _maxSale to bound the maximum amount
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for the sender and recipient
transferFrom spends and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
batchSend credits balanceOf[_to] for each recipient and debits the owner
constructor initialises the owner state variable
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals
constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router address
transfer implicitly uses msg.sender as the spending account

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only the recipient parameter of transfer and carries no distinct semantics
_value is only the amount parameter of transfer
_from is the source parameter of transferFrom and feeds ensure and balanceOf
_to is the recipient parameter of transferFrom and is credited in balanceOf
_value is the amount parameter of transferFrom driving all unchecked arithmetic
a is the delegatecall target parameter of delegate, the source of the unsafe operation
b is the calldata parameter forwarded into the delegatecall
saleNum is the configuration parameter written into _saleNum by init
token is the minimum-sale configuration parameter of init
maxToken is the maximum-sale configuration parameter of init
_tos is the recipient array parameter iterated by batchSend
_value is the per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend
total is the local accumulation of the unchecked multiplication inside batchSend
i is a purely local loop counter inside batchSend
_from is the caller-controlled parameter of ensure used for whitelist comparisons
_value is the parameter of ensure passed directly to condition
_name is a constructor parameter assigned to the name state variable
_symbol is a constructor parameter assigned to the symbol state variable
_supply is the constructor parameter scaled into totalSupply
_UNI is a local pair address computed by pairFor inside ensure and used only for the whitelist check
